decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models that is close to the core assortment and the firm's stated direction, management is likely to stay committed absent clear failure signals.
This organic snack product fits the established meat-specialties business and the expansion of organic lines, so with no strong evidence of disappointment the firm would likely continue it.

Because this premium salami snack line stays close to existing capabilities and already spans several models, sunk development and merchandising effort make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
